meta.name: pi-planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让AI助手把多步任务拆解成计划文件,中断后能接着干。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常让AI处理需要很多步骤、容易中途断掉的复杂工作。
copy.tagline_en: Let AI assistants persist multi-step plans to files and resume after interruptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your AI assistant often loses track of long tasks and needs reliable planning.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 在开始复杂任务前会先创建 task_plan.md、findings.md 和 progress.md，把任务拆成阶段，逐步执行并随时记录发现、错误和进度；每次做重要决策前都会重读计划文件。
howto.when: 当用户要求规划、分解或组织多步骤任务，或任务预计需要 5 次以上工具调用时触发；/clear 后也会自动读取计划文件恢复上下文。

say.text: 请为我制定一个多步骤研究计划，并保存到项目文件里。
say.note: 将创建计划文件并开始跟踪。

say.text: 把当前任务分解成阶段，用规划文件记录进度。
say.note: 每个阶段完成后会更新文件。

say.text: 我清空了会话，请读取之前的 task_plan.md 继续。
say.note: 自动恢复上次的工作上下文。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md before starting a complex task, breaks the work into phases, tracks progress, findings, and errors, and re-reads the plan before major decisions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step task, or when the work is expected to require 5+ tool calls; after /clear it automatically reads plan files to recover context.

say_en.text: Please create a multi-step research plan and save it to project files.
say_en.note: Will create plan files and start tracking.

say_en.text: Break down the current task into phases and track progress with planning files.
say_en.note: Files will be updated after each phase.

say_en.text: I cleared the session; please read the previous task_plan.md and continue.
